art_direction: Minimal lateral 2D dark-fantasy pixel-art-inspired storyboard; cool moonlit shadows, rare silver and amber focal lights, clean silhouette language, no copied external designs.

assets.prompt: A wordless six-panel post-first-boss comic reference: Shar arrives to examine the mortal untouched by calamities harming the Thalestriel; Lolth offers visions of her remembered former godhood from a prior plane; Shar accepts a bargain; Shar uses the ornate wand O Beijo de Shar to apply the Shadow Mark; Lolth transforms from elf to drow; Shar hands her the wand, which is visually tied to command over shadow creatures. No readable words.
